entities.name: board/standing-questions.md
entities.description: The card describing standing questions — a stored cue asked of a session the moment it opens a card, currently status doing.

entities.name: Henri
entities.description: The keeper who observed sessions cannot surface what they weren't asked about, requested standing questions be implemented, and chose which candidates stand.

entities.name: board/README.md
entities.description: Document whose seven moves are 'prose' — nothing in it fires a question at a session at a moment, and whose 'Question it into existence' section says no check can tell whether a question was asked.

entities.name: doc/notes/notes-on-cues.md
entities.description: Document with the section 'Can an introspective index be built?' referenced as related background.

entities.name: board/standing.md
entities.description: The file holding the standing questions and candidates, including the 'proposed' heading where unchosen candidates wait.

entities.name: tools/standing.py
entities.description: The hook that asks the standing questions, a PostToolUse hook on Read and Bash, built with --hook, --check, --install like its predecessors.

entities.name: test/test_standing.py
entities.description: The test file that lands and verifies tools/standing.py's behavior.

entities.name: card:backlinks.md
entities.description: The prior card this hook is shaped after, including its measure of being used (backlinks --earned).

entities.name: tools/bars.py
entities.description: An existing hook on Read, one of the two prior examples of the hook shape that standing.py borrows from.

entities.name: tools/backlinks.py
entities.description: An existing hook on Read|Bash, the other prior example of the hook shape, whose shell parsing is borrowed outright by standing.py.

entities.name: .claude/settings.json
entities.description: Settings file denied to a session by the leash; Henri must paste the install line for tools/standing.py --install for the hook to activate.

entities.name: PostToolUse
entities.description: The hook type on which standing questions land in front of a session, triggered on Read and Bash, the same way citers of a file arrive.

entities.name: seven moves
entities.description: The moves described in board/README.md that stay where they are; standing questions make one or two of them happen on a clock instead of by memory.

entities.name: Question it into existence
entities.description: A section of board/README.md stating that no check can tell whether a question was asked, underpinning why standing questions are not a checklist.

entities.name: backlinks --earned
entities.description: A measure counting a follow — a fire whose offered file was opened next — considered as a model for judging standing questions but with no equivalent artefact yet.

entities.name: git log
entities.description: Used to check correlation between a standing question's fire and whether the card's own file was edited in the same sitting afterward.

entities.name: kaizen
entities.description: A meeting where Henri could be asked directly whether a standing question changed anything — one option (testimony) for judging the mechanism.

entities.name: guest session
entities.description: A session, relayed by Henri, that critiqued the original design for asking the fast system to generate its own cue, prompting the fix to change the question's source.

entities.name: fixme.md
entities.description: Considered and rejected as another place a standing question might fire, since a card is the one place a session is about to decide something.

entities.name: proposed heading
entities.description: The heading in board/standing.md under which candidate standing questions wait rather than being self-promoted by a session.

relations.description: Henri asked for standing questions to be implemented and chose among proposed candidates.
The card notes nothing in board/README.md's seven moves fires a question at a moment — they are prose.
The card points to this document's section on building an introspective index as related.
board/standing.md holds the actual questions and candidates that this card's mechanism asks.
tools/standing.py is the hook implementing the standing-questions mechanism described in the card.
test/test_standing.py is the landing that tests the standing-questions hook.
The hook is shaped after card:backlinks.md and its measure of being used.
tools/standing.py is the third hook of the shape first established by tools/bars.py.
tools/standing.py borrows its shell parsing outright from tools/backlinks.py.
The hook does nothing until its install line is pasted into .claude/settings.json.
Henri pasted the settings line activating the standing-questions hook before the choosing was even reported.
tools/standing.py is a PostToolUse hook on Read and Bash that delivers the standing questions.
The seven moves are board/README.md's own description of the questioning process, left unchanged by this mechanism.
The hook makes one or two of the seven moves happen on a clock instead of when somebody remembers.
'Question it into existence' is a section within board/README.md establishing that no check can confirm a question was asked.
Candidate standing questions wait under board/standing.md's proposed heading rather than being self-promoted.
The guest session's critique that a session inventing its own cue defeats the purpose reshaped the card's design.
Henri relayed the guest session's critique the same morning the design was first built.
backlinks --earned is considered as a model measure but has no direct equivalent yet for standing questions.
git log is proposed as the tool to check correlation between a question's fire and a card's file being edited afterward.
Asking Henri at the kaizen whether a question changed anything is offered as one option for judging the mechanism.
The card considers and rejects firing a standing question on fixme.md or a spec, restricting it to cards.
backlinks --earned is card:backlinks.md's own measure of being used.
test/test_standing.py verifies the behavior of tools/standing.py.
Henri approved the session's picks of specific standing questions recorded in board/standing.md.
